name: runbook
description: Skills for building, recording and hardening a runbook: a protocol-driven workflow whose next step a program decides from recorded facts.

interface.shortDescription: Build, record and harden a protocol-driven runbook.
interface.longDescription: Skills for a runbook, a fixed and checked way to handle a case: build a protocol-driven workflow to its first clean pass, turn a manual session into a draft runbook, and check and harden a protocol with route checks, simulation and measured experiments.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use the workflow-builder skill to build a runbook for this case.
